title: Translating long speech with a way back to what was said
description: The recording does not end at every pause, and the earlier fragments are there to read.

blocks.text: A lecture and a turn-taking conversation need different boundaries for the recording. A listener may want to go back to the previous sentence.

quote.text: Expect for the Ray-Ban smart glasses, I have not seen a concurrent translator app. This app will continually translate audio into translated text. Helpful but it still doesn't allow me to listen continuously while a speaker is giving a lecture or watch a movie with real time translation.

blocks.text: Separate continuous listening from short lines. Tie the recognized stretches to the translation and to the time, and mark the gaps.
Long speech accumulates errors and lag. What is needed is clear limits on a session and the option to check an important spot against the original recording.
